lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
    rw [funext_iff]; by_contra h₀
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀
    have hinner : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
      Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
    have hself : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (real_inner_self_nonneg') fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      ((hinner.continuousAt).preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hself))
    haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
    let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ :=
      ⟨δ / 2, δ, div_pos hδpos two_pos, half_lt_self hδpos⟩
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ_testfun, hφ_pos_x₀, hφ_non_neg, hφ_support_subset, hφ_pos_inner⟩ :
      ∃ φ : Y → ℝ, IsTestFunction φ ∧ φ x₀ > 0 ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧
        Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ/2), 0 < φ x) :=
      ⟨φ1.toFun, ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩,
        φ1.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self φ1.rOut_pos), fun x _ => φ1.nonneg,
        (ContDiffBump.support_eq φ1).subset, fun x hx => φ1.pos_of_mem_ball
          (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx)
            (half_lt_self hδpos)))⟩
    have key_integral := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
      (IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const)
    simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
    have supp_subset2 : Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) ⊆ Function.support φ :=
      fun x hx => (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hx).1
    have integrable_prod :
      Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
      (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hinner).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hφ_testfun.supp.mono supp_subset2)
    have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
      intro x
      rcases eq_or_ne (φ x) 0 with h | h
      · rw [h, zero_mul]
      · exact mul_nonneg (hφ_non_neg x h) (hδ (hφ_support_subset h)).le
    have hμ : 0 < μ (Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ/2)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ
        (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (div_pos hδpos two_pos)))
        (measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
    have closedBall_subset_support :
        Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ/2)
          ⊆ Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := fun x hx =>
        mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hφ_pos_inner x hx)) (ne_of_gt (hδ
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hδpos) hx)))
    have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
      (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg h_nonneg integrable_prod).mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ (measure_mono closedBall_subset_support))
    exact integral_pos.ne key_integral.symm

open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro Hnorm
  have app2 {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h1 : a ⊆ c) (h2 : b ⊆ d) : a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h1)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h2)
  induction Hnorm with
  | const | bvar | op | fvar => apply List.nil_subset
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih1 ih2 | eq _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact app2 ih1 ih2
  | ite _ _ _ ih1 ih2 ih3 => exact app2 (app2 ih1 ih2) ih3
  | app _ _ h3 ih1 ih2 =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . intro x hx
      exact hx
    . next Hfalse =>
      exfalso
      cases h3 IsOldPred.oldPred
      exact Hfalse _ _ _ rfl
    . exact app2 ih1 ih2

  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  induction post
  all_goals simp only [substOld]
  all_goals repeat' split
  all_goals simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] at *
  all_goals grind only

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  calc _
    _= 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
        rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub]
        simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
        rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
          fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
          fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
        simp [Time.deriv_eq]
        · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
        simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
        apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        simp [mul_sub]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _), Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rfl
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ] at h
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1, 2, 2, 2, x]
          rw [show (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x = (1/𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t x from
            (h t x).1.trans (by ring)]
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t x) x :=
          Differentiable.differentiableAt
            (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
              (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t)
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis i (fun x => (1/𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t x) x,
          fderiv_const_mul hd]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [𝓕.c_sq]
        field_simp

    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t

    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k

      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | red_l
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | red_r
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨_, Red.abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.appᵣ val_l red_r.choose_spec⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l.choose_spec⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨_, Red.tabs val.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc red.choose_spec⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have hb := (body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_bind red.choose_spec hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der).imp Value.inl fun r => ⟨_, Red.inl r.choose_spec⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der).imp Value.inr fun r => ⟨_, Red.inr r.choose_spec⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have hb := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      · cases val with | inl v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inl v hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
      · cases val with | inr v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inr v hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.case red.choose_spec hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
  case abs => left; exact Value.abs der'.wf.2.1
  case tabs => left; exact Value.tabs der'.wf.2.1
  all_goals grind

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun (x : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
    (_ : x ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) =>
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * x) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * x))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun (y : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
      (_ : y ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) =>
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(y * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(y * ofCrAnListF φs)))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    · rintro y ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
      have hmid : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) =
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
      let l := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      let l' := List.filter (fun c =>
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
      let r := List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      let r' := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
        (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
        (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      have h3 : List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs) = l ++ (l' ++ (r' ++ r)) := by
        rw [insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs]
        simp only [l, l', r, r', List.append_assoc]
      have e1 : φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs := by simp
      have e2 : φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs := by simp
      calc ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs)
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm,
              ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
              ofList_singleton, map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [sub_right_inj]
          rw [smul_comm]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l') * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF r') * ι (ofCrAnListF r)) := by
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, crAnTimeOrderList, e1, h1,
            crAnTimeOrderList, e2, h2]
          simp only [map_mul, mul_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, l, l', r, r', hmid.symm,
            mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          simp only [mul_assoc]
          rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
            ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          rw [← h3, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
              (by push_neg at hq; exact hq.symm),
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
    · intro x y _ _ hpx hpy
      simp only [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, hpx, hpy]
    · intro x hx _ h
      simp only [smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]
      exact congrArg (x • ·) h
  · simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intro x y _ _ hpx hpy
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, hpx, hpy]
  · intro x hx _ h
    simp only [Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]
    exact congrArg (x • ·) h

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by

  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    obtain ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp
      (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_univ (0 : C_i))⟩)
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, h_eq.symm⟩
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    let ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    let Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    let Fib := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) =>
      ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps)))).toFinset
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Y_bad.toFinset.biUnion Fib := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y_of_x,
        Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx_in_ΔH).2⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Fib, coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x),
        is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
          (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp rfl⟩
    have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ _y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, (Fib _y).card ≤ 2 ^ steps := by
      intro y _
      have hy := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps y
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset] at hy
      simp only [Fib, Set.toFinset_card, coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset,
        le_refl, hy]
    have h_Y_ncard : Y_bad.toFinset.card = Y_bad.ncard := by
      rw [Set.toFinset_card, ←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, card_eq_fintype_card]
    refine (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans ?_
    refine (Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul Y_bad.toFinset Fib _ h_card_fiber_of_each_y).trans ?_
    rw [h_Y_ncard]
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps :=
    le_trans (sInf_le ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_refl _⟩) h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)))]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_bridge (ENat.coe_lt_top _))
  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H.toNat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← h_algebraic_identity]
    have hmon : d_H.toNat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
      exact_mod_cast ENat.toNat_le_toNat h_dist_bridge (ENat.coe_ne_top (d_fw * 2 ^ steps))
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hmon)
      (by rw [←Nat.mul_assoc]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound)
  change (2 : ℕ∞) * d_H < d_i
  rw [←ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0 h_final_inequality

    obtain ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp
      (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_univ (0 : C_i))⟩)
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, h_eq.symm⟩
  have h_nat : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [h_g'_min_card]
    let ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    let Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'

      intro x hx_in_ΔH

      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y_of_x,
        Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx_in_ΔH).2⟩, ?_⟩

      rw [Set.toFinset_card, ←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, card_eq_fintype_card]
    refine (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans ?_
    refine (Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul Y_bad.toFinset Fib _ h_card_fiber_of_each_y).trans ?_
    rw [h_Y_ncard]

  change (2 : ℕ∞) * d_H < d_i
  rw [←ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0 h_final_inequality

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := (hrelation d e).mp h.1
  obtain ⟨-, h4⟩ := (hrelation e f).mp h.2
  -- replacing digit i of x by y i changes the number by (y i - x i) * 10^i
  have key : ∀ (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9),
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j)
        = digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro x y i
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb => by rw [if_neg hb, sub_self])
        (fun hb => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hb),
      if_pos rfl, ← sub_mul]
  have hce : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have hE : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1)
        - 7 * digits_to_num d = digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin]; ring
    exact hE ▸ dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => key d e i ▸ h2 i) ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
  have hstep : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h5 := dvd_add (key d e i ▸ h2 i) (key e f i ▸ h4 i)
    rw [add_add_add_comm, ← add_mul, sub_add_sub_cancel'] at h5
    have h6 := dvd_sub h5 hce
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at h6
  intro i
  rcases (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp (hstep i) with h | h
  · rwa [← dvd_neg, neg_sub]
  · norm_cast at h
    exact absurd (Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h) (by decide)
